下载后就能直接使用 AI 吗？: Can I use AI immediately after installing?
在线模型需要你自己的服务商账号、API Key 及可用额度。easy API平台: Online models require your own account, API key and quota. The Platform also includes local easyAI models, whose capability and speed depend on the model and hardware. easy Code and Otti primarily use your configured API.
可以。附件按钮支持添加一个不超过 200 MB 的本地视频，在本机均匀提取最多: Yes. Attach a local video up to 200 MB. Up to 12 timestamped frames are sampled locally and sent to a vision model. Preview them via the thumbnail and attach SRT/VTT captions separately. Audio is not transcribed and brief events may be missed.
视频无法读取，应该怎么办？: What if a video cannot be read?
视频扩展名不能保证编码受支持。请优先使用常见 H.264 MP4 或 VP8/V: Extensions do not guarantee codec support. Prefer H.264 MP4 or VP8/VP9 WebM. Corrupt files, unsupported codecs, timeouts or files over 200 MB produce an error. Convert or trim the clip and retry.
八种模式需要八个 API 吗？: Do eight modes require eight APIs?
不需要。聊天、写作和编码可使用同一个兼容模型服务，但不同模式对能力的要求不同。图: No. Chat, writing and coding can share one compatible service. Media generation requires the appropriate interface, vision tasks need vision, and tools need tool calling. Blender and Office must be installed locally for those workflows.
Training 会把我的模型训练得更强吗？: Does Training improve my model's weights?
不会修改模型权重。它让你在当前对话中创建、查看和迭代提示词，帮助组织协作规则。效: No. It manages and refines prompts in the current conversation. Results depend on the chosen model and the information you provide.
easy API平台附带的本地 easyAI 模型可用于本地文本对话，前提是本地: Built-in easyAI models can handle local text conversations when the runtime is available. Online models, web search and external generation services need internet access. Local models do not replace every online capability.
为什么不同服务的思考、图片或工具能力不同？: Why do reasoning, vision and tools vary by service?
应用提供统一入口，但模型能力和参数由服务商决定。部分服务可能忽略某些参数，或不支: The app unifies access, but providers determine model capabilities and parameters. Some ignore parameters or lack certain tools, attachments or media interfaces. Test the service and try a small task first.
需要 Windows 7 或 macOS 版本？: Is there a Windows 7 or macOS version?
本页提供的是 Windows 10 / 11 x64 安装包。当前未提供 Win: These installers target Windows 10 / 11 x64. No Windows 7, macOS or mobile installer is currently provided.

在线请求会发送到你配置的模型服务。根据功能和授权，请求可能包含任务、附件、网页内: Requests go to your configured model service and may include tasks, attachments, web content or screenshots, depending on features and authorization. Review app permissions and provider privacy policies. This static website does not collect API keys.

检测到用户操作时，Otti 会暂停电脑任务；当前版本在用户停止操作约 4 秒后可: User input pauses Otti's computer task, which can resume after about 4 idle seconds. Shared desktops still have focus, input-detection and permission limitations. Manually pause for passwords, codes or payment information; use emergency stop to halt work.

可以。安装向导默认选择 D 盘。没有 D 盘或空间不足时，请在向导中选择其他合适: Yes. Installers default to drive D. If unavailable or low on space, choose a different folder in the installer.

首页的工作空间是用于介绍产品的界面示意，不是实时应用或真实任务结果。下载后请按实: The homepage workspace is an illustrative interface, not a live app or real task result. Verify tasks using your actual models, permissions and computer environment.
